title: A Guide To Facebook Advertising In Singapore: How To Get Started

facts.fact: The article states that all Facebook ad options can be grouped into three categories: campaigns, ad sets, and ads.
facts.quote: all options can be grouped into three categories:

facts.fact: The article lists five campaign objectives that Facebook Ads Manager prompts advertisers to select from: brand awareness, increase traffic, lead generation, conversions, and sales.
facts.quote: the first thing that the ad manager will prompt you to select is the objective of your campaign:

facts.fact: The Facebook Ads Manager audience definition gauge is split into three levels: specific, balanced, and broad.
facts.quote: The audience definition gauge is split between specific, balanced, and broad.

facts.fact: Facebook offers two budget options: daily budget and lifetime budget.
facts.quote: There are two budget options that Facebook offers.

facts.fact: With a daily budget, Facebook adjusts the daily spend, and this option is recommended if the ad set should run all day long.
facts.quote: This is recommended if you want your ad set to run all day long.

facts.fact: A lifetime budget is recommended for ad campaigns running for a set duration, with Facebook pacing total spend over that period instead of adjusting to daily spending.
facts.quote: For ad campaigns running for a certain duration, this would be recommended.

facts.fact: Facebook campaign budgets can be further customised by setting a set schedule, accelerating delivery, or bidding for optimised reach.
facts.quote: by setting a set schedule, accelerating your delivery, or bidding for optimised reach

facts.fact: Facebook Ads Manager shows how much a business is spending each day on current campaigns, along with key results such as frequency and reach.
facts.quote: It shows how much your business is spending each day on current campaigns and key results such as frequency and reach.

facts.fact: The article was published on 25 February 2022.
